# Vendored front-end code

The panel works in a home network that may have no internet access, so
third-party scripts are kept here and compiled into the server binary.

| File | Version | Source | SHA-256 | License |
|------|---------|--------|---------|---------|
| `htmx.min.js` | 2.0.8 | https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2.0.8/dist/htmx.min.js | `22283ef68cb7545914f0a88a1bdedc7256a703d1d580c1d255217d0a50d31313` | 0BSD (`htmx.LICENSE`) |

To update, download the new release from the same place, read its
changelog for breaking changes, and record the version and checksum here.
